messages.subject: Bioconductor
parts:
Hi, 

I'm a huge fan of Shiny and I've been following the development for a while, so thanks to all the developers! 

What's the timescale on shinyapps.io getting Bioconductor Support?

Cheers,

Andrew

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Bioconductor
parts:
Thanks for the kind words Andrew.  We should be adding support for BioConductor in the next 2-3 months.  Sorry it is a little vague still, we are working primarily on improvements to the reliability, scalability, performance and ease of use of the platform right now.  Some of those changes have already rolled out, others are coming in the next 3-4 weeks.  Depending on how it all goes, adding support for both BioConductor and R-Forge is something that we have heard the need for in the past.

-Tareef
